text_block_list.text:
While in the middle of an outing with King 
Halo—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Looks like there's quite a crowd 
gathered over there?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't it this? The aquarium's 
signboard says the baby seal is making its 
debut.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's not something you see every day, 
which is probably why so many people have 
gathered here.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? I-It's fine, really...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
King is first-rate, so mingling with 
common crowds hardly suits me! 
Oho-ho-ho-ho!
choice_data_list: Are you not good with crowds?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! Th-that's right! It throws off my 
pace, or something like that...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Besides, with it this crowded, there's no 
way we'd get a proper look even if we went 
inside!
choice_data_list:
Then let's look around without getting 
swept up by the crowd.
Then let's push our way through the crowd.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So you don't get swallowed by the 
crowd...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see, reading the waves of the crowd, 
huh. Not a bad idea at all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Backing down like this wouldn't be very 
King-like either, so let's go with that 
plan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? The crowd is already swarming in! 
Don't just stand there daydreaming, let's 
go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! I've splendidly bypassed the 
crowd!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well? See that? No one can keep up with 
King's speed!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...So, why did we come into the aquarium 
again...?"

Having devoted herself entirely to 
"running away," King Halo didn't get to 
see the baby seal at all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Push aside...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's true, if I keep avoiding it, people 
might misunderstand and think I'm running 
away...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Even when surrounded by a crowd, you have 
to show the strong will to carve your own 
way through."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Trainer! Let's go with the 
strategy of pushing through the crowd!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright... Beyond that crowd of people 
is the baby seal, right...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out! Burn King's valiant, 
fearless charge into your eyes!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~~!! C-Could you let me 
through~~?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh! It's tight, it's tough! But I 
won't give uuup!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... W-We managed to catch a 
glimpse of them... the seals...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
“Though in the first place... did I really 
want to see a seal badly enough to exhaust 
myself like this...?”

Though utterly exhausted, King Halo did 
not waver or give up, successfully 
achieving her goal.
